However, the prepare/verify/activate requalification could NOT reach PASS_ACTIVE_CONSISTENT: it is BLOCKED, fail-closed, by a pre-existing memory-record-space collision that is independent of the lane C design correction. Per the hard constraint 'factual blocked outcome beats forced pass', requalification was NOT forced, the revision was restored to its prior ACTIVE_CONSISTENT baseline (artifact index 06496a6a, memory active pointer 06496a6a, activation receipt PASS_ACTIVE_CONSISTENT), and the acceptance rung REMAINS at v4. requalification_blocker.root_cause: The prepare gate lists the qualification collection (project_knowledge) filtered by (run_id, revision_id) and requires the space to contain EXACTLY the 27 qualification records (1 revision + 10 phase + 16 required_artifact). That same (run_id, revision_id) space also contains 14 governance/audit records written by the sanctioned persist_* memory path (reviewer_calibration_v2/v3/v4, negative_control, hardened_rereview, successor_rereview_v4, step38_lipsync_decision, lane_c_sb_003_end_regen, lane_c_blocker, acceptance_rung_v2/v3/v4, state_clearing_audit, anchored_identity_standard). 13 of these predate this session. The gate therefore reports them as unexpected_keys and blocks.
requalification_blocker.why_not_resolvable_here: Resolving it requires removing the 14 governance records from the qualification filter space, but the Memory daemon exposes NO deletion primitive: there is no /delete endpoint, and /query rejects destructive AQL ('Destructive AQL forbidden: REMOVE'). The governance records cannot be relocated without deletion. Editing the prepare gate to exclude governance record_types would be a gate change (not authorized here). Deleting durable audit records to slip past the gate would be forcing a pass.

Once the collision is resolved: re-run the artifact-index rebuild + supersession (promoting sha256:9f8fb8c9... and retaining the phase_c frame as superseded), prepare/verify/activate --supersede to PASS_ACTIVE_CONSISTENT, then emit acceptance_rung_receipt.v5 = PASS_ACCEPTANCE_RUNG citing calibration v4, the 8-frame re-review, the lane C waiver receipts, the supersession ledger, and activation.
